result.reason: The operative language does not reach either playbook position. New subsection (a) permits Licensee affiliate/successor assignments without consent, but unchanged subsection (c) still prohibits all Licensee assignments and transfers without Licensor consent, creating a direct conflict. The draft also imposes no reciprocal restriction on Licensor: it lacks Customer consent rights, the reasonableness standard, and the absolute prohibition on assignment to a Customer competitor. The retained sentence concerning when Licensor may reasonably withhold change-of-control consent is obsolete and inconsistent with the new no-consent/no-termination language. Further, allowing assignment “in whole or in part” unnecessarily expands the intended carve-out and may permit partial assignment. The margin comment correctly identifies one issue but does not cure these operative defects.
